rows.quote: The GWAS dataset for telomere length (sample size: 472,174, population: European) was derived from a GWAS study by Codd et al. [22].
rows.dataset_named_in_source: GWAS study by Codd et al.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the telomere length GWAS by Codd et al. in UK Biobank as the outcome dataset; no outcome dictionary row is for it.

rows.quote: METHODS: Using plasma cis-pQTLs data from a previous GWAS study (3,606 Pqtls associated with 2,656 proteins) and a GWAS dataset of telomere length (sample size: 472,174; GWAS ID: ieu-b-4879) from UK Biobank, using MR, external validation, and reverse causality testing, we identified essential drug target proteins for telomere length.
rows.coder_note: Abstract sentence names the outcome dataset by OpenGWAS id ieu-b-4879 (telomere length, UK Biobank); no dictionary row lists it.
